description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2
Operations to upload shipment documents.

Add a document to a specific shipment.

Before the document is actually added to the shipment the uploaded content must pass a
security scan and conversion to [PDF/A](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PDF/A). This is done asynchronously 
and usually only takes a couple of seconds. For the future it is planned to immediately scan and convert the document.

formdata.description:
(Required) Content of the document (preferably a PDF) that should be added to the shipment.

Must have 
* a size of max. 10 MB
* a supported file extension 
  * pdf
  * docx/doc
  * xlsx/xls
  * png
  * jpeg/jpg
  * tiff/tif
  * rtf
  * bmp
* in case of a PDF: no read protection
